title: Spec 21 grand scorecard: LW-LDA, BBP probe, logit adjustment vs linear / adapter / SupCon (1-SE)

protocol.selection: canonical Breiman 1-SE on pooled OOF accuracy over gate-passing candidates; simplest by Spec 21 S6 supervised parameter count, ties by fixed family order
protocol.gate: OOF gate (selection): pooled OOF acc >= train majority prior and no class > 95% of predictions. Test gate (admission, post-selection): same test on the test split.

baseline_comparison.delta_ci_note: the baseline report stores only correct/n per task, so its predictions cannot be paired with ours; the two macro CIs are independent bootstraps and the delta has no paired test. The paired test is full vs legacy3_tau0, re-run in this script.
